title.narrative: Sustainability and environment aid roadmap for the private sector

description.narrative:
To create a sustainability guide for SMEs: the practical guide will includes specific actions that Mexican SMEs can carry out to increase climate change awareness and environmental protection and align their different business activities with the 17 SDGs established in the 2030 Agenda, allowing them to incorporate a sustainable development approach in all business areas.
To create the energy sector white paper on the national content in the value chain of the production technologies and use of green hydrogen: to carry out a detailed technical analysis of each component of the technologies, materials, national inputs, and potential national content (percentage) of electrolysers, fuel cells, electric turbines, Power to X, and small-scale storage (tanks). Accordingly, technical sheets will be prepared for each technology.
Publication and dissemination of the main findings.
